en.headline: Three vehicles collide inside Aberdeen Tunnel, no injuries
en.dek: A coach and two private cars were involved in the Wan Chai-bound tube around 8 a.m.; one car was badly damaged and a lane was briefly closed.
body: Three vehicles collided inside the Aberdeen Tunnel on Wednesday morning, but no one was injured.

Police said the accident occurred at about 8 a.m. in the tube heading towards Wan Chai. Two private cars travelling in the fast lane collided, and one of them then hit a coach that was in the slow lane.
One of the private cars was severely damaged and ended up blocking both lanes. The slow lane was closed temporarily, causing congestion that stretched back towards Wong Chuk Hang Road.
The affected lane was later reopened and traffic gradually cleared. Police are investigating the cause.

zh.headline: 香港仔隧道三車相撞 無人受傷
zh.dek: 早上近8時，往灣仔方向管道內兩架私家車相撞後再撞旅遊巴，一車嚴重損毀，慢線一度封閉。
body: 香港仔隧道發生三車相撞意外，無人受傷。
警方表示，事件發生於周三早上近8時，往灣仔方向管道內。當時兩架私家車在快線行駛時相撞，其中一架再撞到正在慢線行駛的旅遊巴。
其中一架私家車嚴重損毀，橫亘在兩條行車線上。受影響的慢線一度封閉，交通擠塞延伸至黃竹坑道一帶。
其後行車線解封，車龍逐漸消散。警方正調查意外原因。
